Metadata.title: HimLand Check: search and check land records in Himachal Pradesh
Metadata.description: Read, understand and check Himachal Pradesh land records in one place: jamabandi, khasra, khatauni, khewat, mutations, maps and shajra, pre-purchase reports and a land marketplace. An independent private platform, not a government website.

Disclaimer.banner: Private, independent platform. Not a government website. Information is not an official record: verify with the Revenue Department before you act.

points.independent: This is a private, independent platform. It is not owned, operated, endorsed or authorised by the Government of Himachal Pradesh, the Revenue Department or any government agency.
points.notLegalRecord: Information shown here is for general reference only. It is not an official or certified land record and cannot be used as proof of ownership, title, possession or boundaries in any court, office or transaction. Only a certified copy (nakal) issued by the competent Revenue authority is valid.
points.accuracy: Records may be incomplete, outdated, wrongly transcribed or different from the current official entries. We do not guarantee accuracy, completeness or timeliness.
points.verify: Before you buy, sell, lend against or otherwise deal in any land, always verify every detail with the local Patwari, the Tehsil office or the official government portal.
points.noAdvice: Nothing on this platform is legal, financial or professional advice. Pre-purchase reports are informational summaries, not an opinion on title. Consult a qualified advocate.
points.landLaws: Transfer of land in Himachal Pradesh may be restricted, or may need prior permission, under laws such as the H.P. Tenancy and Land Reforms Act, 1972 (including Section 118). Check your eligibility before entering into any transaction.
points.marketplace: Marketplace listings are posted by third parties. We do not own, inspect or verify the listed land and are not a party to any transaction. A “verified” badge, where shown, only means that basic checks were done. It is not a guarantee of title.
points.liability: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we accept no liability for any loss or damage arising from the use of, or reliance on, this platform.

page.title: Disclaimer
page.intro: Please read this disclaimer carefully before using HimLand Check. By using the website you confirm that you have read and understood it.
page.reports: A pre-purchase check report summarises the entries we hold for a plot and highlights points you may want to verify. It is an informational aid. It is not a title search, a title opinion, or a guarantee that a plot is free of dispute, mortgage, encumbrance or litigation.

steps.a: Note the district, tehsil, village and the khasra, khewat and khatauni numbers from our result.
steps.b: Visit the Patwari or Tehsil office, or use the official government land-records portal, and ask for a certified copy (nakal) of the current entry.
steps.c: Compare the certified copy with what you saw here: owner names, shares, area and land type.
steps.d: Check for mutations, mortgages and court orders, and ask a qualified advocate to review the documents before you pay any money.

About.title: About HimLand Check
About.intro: HimLand Check is a simpler way to read, understand and check government land records — for villages in Himachal Pradesh.

whatWeDo.title: What we do
whatWeDo.body: We make public revenue records — jamabandi, khasra, khatauni, khewat, mutations — searchable in one place, show them on maps and shajra drawings, and produce pre-purchase check reports. There is also a marketplace where people list land themselves.

whatWeAreNot.title: What we are not
whatWeAreNot.body: HimLand Check is an independent private platform. It is not affiliated with or authorised by the Government of Himachal Pradesh or any revenue department. Our copies are not a substitute for a certified government copy. Always confirm with the relevant Tehsil / Patwari office before any transaction.

whoRuns.title: Who runs it
whoRuns.body: Operated by {company} LLP, a limited liability partnership registered in India.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data HimLand Check collects, why we collect it and the choices you have. It applies to this website and the services offered on it. By using the service you agree to this policy.

who.title: Who we are
body: HimLand Check is operated by {company} LLP (“we”, “us”), a limited liability partnership registered in India. For the purposes of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, we are the data fiduciary for the personal data described here.
Questions or requests about your data can be sent to {email}.

collect.title: What we collect
body: We collect only what we need to run the service:
- Account details: name, email address, phone number and preferred language when you sign up.
- Search activity: the district, tehsil, village, khasra or owner-name searches you run, and the records or reports you open.
- Listings and uploads: the details, contact information and photographs you add when you post land on the marketplace.
- Report requests and payment status for reports you order. When paid reports are offered, card and bank details are handled by the payment provider and are not stored by us.
- Technical data: IP address, browser and device type, pages visited and error logs, used for security and to keep the service running.

publicRecords.title: Land records and personal data
body: Land records contain the names of owners and related persons. We compile this information from public revenue records and from information supplied by users, and we show it for reference only.
If you believe an entry about you is wrong, or you want it reviewed, write to {email} with the details of the record. We will look into it and reply within a reasonable time.

use.title: How we use your data
body: - To create and secure your account and sign you in.
- To run searches, show records and generate reports.
- To publish and moderate marketplace listings.
- To contact you about your account, your requests and important changes.
- To prevent fraud and abuse and to meet legal obligations.
- To understand how the service is used so we can improve it.

consent.title: Consent and lawful use
body: We process your personal data with your consent, or for other uses the law allows, such as complying with a legal obligation. You can withdraw consent at any time. This does not affect processing done before you withdrew it, and some features may stop working.

sharing.title: Who we share data with
body: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with service providers that help us run the service, under appropriate safeguards:
- Supabase, which provides our database, authentication and file storage.
- Our website hosting and content-delivery provider.
- Payment and communication providers, if and when we use them.
We may also disclose data when required by law, a court order or a government authority, or to protect our rights and the safety of users.
Marketplace listings you publish, including any contact details you choose to show, are visible to other visitors.

location.title: Where data is processed
body: Our providers may store and process data on servers in India or in other countries. Where data leaves India we take steps to keep it protected as the law requires.

cookies.title: Cookies and similar technologies
body: At the time of the last update we use only the cookies and browser storage that are necessary to run the service: keeping you signed in and remembering your language choice.
We do not use advertising cookies. If we add analytics or other optional cookies we will update this policy and ask for your consent where required.

retention.title: How long we keep data
body: We keep account data while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterwards. Server logs are kept for a limited period. We may keep some information for longer where the law requires or to resolve disputes. When data is no longer needed we delete or anonymise it.

security.title: Security
body: We use access controls, encrypted connections and database-level row security to protect data. No online service is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. Please use a strong password and keep it private.

rights.title: Your rights
body: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you may:
- ask for a summary of the personal data we hold about you;
- ask us to correct or complete inaccurate data;
- ask us to erase data that is no longer needed;
- nominate another person to exercise your rights if you die or become unable to do so;
- raise a grievance with us and, if it is not resolved, complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
To use these rights, write to {email}. We may ask you to verify your identity first.

children.title: Children
body: The service is not meant for people under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you think a child has given us data, contact us and we will delete it.

grievance.title: Grievance contact
body: For privacy questions, requests or complaints, contact {company} LLP at {email}. We will acknowledge your request promptly and aim to resolve it within a reasonable time.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The “last updated” date at the top shows when it last changed. If a change is significant we will tell you on the website or by email.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: These terms govern your use of HimLand Check. Please read them together with our Disclaimer and Privacy policy. By using the website, creating an account or posting a listing you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

about.title: About the service
body: HimLand Check is an independent private platform operated by {company} LLP. It lets you search and read land-record information, view maps, request pre-purchase check reports and browse or post land listings. It is not a government website and is not connected with the Government of Himachal Pradesh or any revenue department.

notOfficial.title: No official status
body: Information on the service is for reference only. It is not an official or certified record and is not proof of ownership, title or possession. You must confirm everything with the Tehsil / Patwari office and obtain a certified copy before you buy, sell, lend against or otherwise deal with land. Please read our Disclaimer.

eligibility.title: Eligibility and accounts
body: You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter into a binding contract under Indian law.
- Give accurate information when you register and keep it up to date.
- Keep your password confidential. You are responsible for activity under your account.
- Tell us at once if you think your account has been misused.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
body: You agree not to:
- use the service for anything unlawful, fraudulent or misleading;
- scrape, copy or republish records in bulk, or use bots or automated tools, without our written permission;
- try to break, probe or overload the service, or bypass its security or access limits;
- upload malware or content that infringes anyone’s rights;
- impersonate another person or misrepresent your relationship with a property.

reports.title: Reports
body: Pre-purchase check reports summarise information we hold and point out items to verify. They are not a title search, legal opinion or guarantee. Do not rely on a report as the only basis for a purchase or lending decision.
Fee and refund terms, where they apply, will be shown before you order.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
body: Listings are posted by users, not by us. We do not own, inspect or verify listed land, and we are not a party to any sale, lease or other transaction between users.
If you post a listing, you confirm that:
- you own the land or are legally authorised to offer it;
- the details, price and photographs are accurate and not misleading;
- the sale or transfer is permitted under applicable law, including any restriction or permission requirement under the H.P. Tenancy and Land Reforms Act, 1972;
- you have the right to share any contact details you publish.
We may review, refuse, edit, suspend or remove any listing, and close accounts that break these terms. A “verified” label only means that basic checks were done. It is not a guarantee of title.
If you are a buyer, do your own due diligence and take legal advice before you pay any money.

ip.title: Intellectual property
body: The website, its design, software and original content belong to us or our licensors. The underlying public records belong to the relevant authorities. We give you a limited, personal, non-transferable licence to use the service for lawful purposes. You keep ownership of content you upload, and you give us a licence to host, display and use it to run the service.

availability.title: Availability and changes
body: We try to keep the service running, but we do not promise that it will always be available, error-free or up to date. We may change, suspend or stop any part of it at any time.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services and links
body: The service may rely on, or link to, third-party services. We are not responsible for their content or practices.

warranty.title: No warranties
body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”. To the fullest extent the law allows, we disclaim all warranties, express or implied, including accuracy, completeness, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, {company} LLP and its partners, employees and affiliates are not liable for any indirect, incidental, special or consequential loss, or for loss of money, property, profit, data or opportunity, arising from your use of or reliance on the service or any listing or report.
Where liability cannot be excluded, our total liability to you for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us for the service in the 12 months before the claim.

indemnity.title: Your responsibility
body: You agree to compensate us for loss, claims and costs arising from your breach of these terms, your listings, or your unlawful use of the service.

termination.title: Suspension and termination
body: We may suspend or end your access at any time if you break these terms or the law. You may stop using the service, and ask us to close your account, at any time.

law.title: Governing law and disputes
body: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Subject to any mandatory legal rights you have, the courts at {jurisdiction} have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. The updated version applies from the “last updated” date shown above. If you keep using the service after that date, you accept the changes.

body: Questions about these terms: {company} LLP, {email}.

flags.mortgage: A mortgage mutation ({number}) appears in the history. Check whether it has been cleared.
flags.courtOrder: A court-order mutation ({number}) appears in the history. Ask for the order and check for any ongoing case.
flags.oldJamabandi: The latest jamabandi we hold is from {year}. Ask for the current entry.
flags.agricultural: This is {landType} (agricultural) land. Transfers of agricultural land to non-agriculturists may be restricted or need permission under Section 118 of the H.P. Tenancy and Land Reforms Act, 1972.
flags.unreviewed: This entry has not been independently reviewed by our team.
